quarterly_data.signal: 10-K legal proceedings: on December 12, 2025, Malikie Innovations Ltd. and Key Patent Innovations Ltd. filed suit against Riot, Foundry Digital LLC, Fortitude Mining, LLC and Cipher Mining Inc. in the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas (case 7:25-CV-00567), alleging that the defendants' bitcoin transactions infringe certain patents owned by the plaintiffs and seeking injunctive relief and an unspecified amount of damages. Riot has engaged counsel to evaluate and defend the claim and states it cannot reasonably predict the outcome or its magnitude at this time.
